page.overview:
Who is Teo Fabi?

Teodorico "Teo" Fabi ( ; born 9 March 1955, Milan, , Lombardy, Italy) is an Italian former racing driver who drove in Formula One in the mid-1980s. Despite scoring three pole positions, he never lead a lap in F1. He is the older brother of Corrado Fabi.

Fabi made his F1 début in with the . Failing to score any points, he left for CART, scoring a rookie pole at the Indianapolis 500 and finishing a close second in the championship.

Despite starting a second Champ Car campaign, Fabi made his way back into F1 in , with the . After scoring nine points (including a podium) and suffering a series of retirements, Fabi left racing to run the family mining business after the death of his father. He rejoined Toleman three races into , and scored a surprise pole for the team at the . However, a slipping clutch saw him fall to eighth, eventually retiring due to the clutch issues. Like his first season at Toleman, he failed to score any points.

Staying with the team into , Fabi had his strongest season, scoring twelve points (including a second podium). However, Alessandro Nannini was signed for (to partner Thierry Boutsen, Berger's replacement), and Fabi took out his frustration of a lack of a 1988 driver on Boutsen, deliberately blocking his path despite being a lap down.
